events.summary: Business Wire (Mon, 21 Sep 2026, per Google News RSS) announced Rippling opening an AI lab in Bengaluru; trade press followed on Sep 23 that Rippling's India workforce is approaching 2,500. Dated exactly on the since-date boundary.
events.headline: Rippling Opens AI Lab in Bengaluru to Accelerate the Future of AI-Powered Business Software

events.summary: Rippling updated Automated Compliance to support multi-framework audit programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA templates), broader third-party integrations, a built-in audit portal, publishable trust centers, and embedded AI workflows for framework setup, remediation, and security questionnaires; announced the same day on Rippling's LinkedIn.
events.headline: Reintroducing Rippling Automated Compliance: AI for every stage of compliance

events.summary: Rippling introduced new Rippling AI capabilities — plugins, skills, and automations — letting employees use AI with context on their role, team, and policies, turn proven instructions into reusable prompts, and automate recurring work, governed by existing Rippling permissions and the MCP Gateway.
events.headline: Give every employee AI that has the context to be useful

events.summary: Business Wire release (Oct 8, 2026) on Rippling expanding its NYC office to 132,693 sq ft near Penn Station; CoStar (Oct 9) reported the nearly 133,000 sq ft opening, and Rippling LinkedIn posts confirmed the new NYC office opened that week.
events.headline: Rippling Expands New York City Presence Amid Accelerated Growth
